title: Cleantech Innovation MSc 2026 Show
desc:
At Imperial, we’re fighting climate change with innovation!

From AI‑enabled infrastructure software and radiative cooling technologies to novel systems for water conservation, recycling, and marine decarbonisation, our MSc Cleantech Innovation students are tackling some of today’s most pressing sustainability challenges with creativity and expertise.

This pioneering MSc programme – a joint initiative between the Grantham Institute and the Dyson School of Design Engineering – gives students the opportunity to learn from experts from across the cleantech sector and provides them with the knowledge and tools needed to build and launch their own cleantech solutions. title: Great Service Lunch and Learn: Project staff costing tool
desc:
Atlas will replace ICIS and some other systems (including Teamseer and Talentlink). This means everyone in Imperial will use Atlas in the future.

title: Contextual Design Engineering – DE MSc 2026 Show
desc:
The show celebrates the graduating cohort of the MSc Design Engineering programme, presenting projects at the intersection of engineering and design: creative, transdisciplinary, and built for real-world impact.

This year’s theme, “Designing for Ageing Futures”, explores how design and technology can respond to the opportunities and challenges of an ageing world. From a compact rowing resistance trainer and a music-led tabletop game to finger trainer designed to support dexterity – discover projects built to support wellbeing at every stage of life.

Join our students and see how design engineering can help us build better futures — register now!

title: Paediatric patient safety, quality and equity
desc:
Improving patient safety for children and young people requires not only robust measurement systems, but also intentional integration of patient and family voices into care.

In this one‑hour hybrid seminar, Dr Naomi Bardach – Professor of Pediatrics and Policy at the University of California, San Francisco, and Vice Chair of Health Services Research in Pediatrics – will present highlights from her nationally recognised research programme focused on paediatric patient safety, quality, and equity.

Dr Bardach will share work from her NICHD‑funded research examining inpatient safety events reported directly by patients and families using mobile technology, and how rapidly sharing these observations with hospital staff can drive meaningful safety improvements.

Drawing on her experience…

title: Africa Innovates Conference 2026: New Scientific and Developmental Frontiers
desc:
Africa Innovates is a conference that aims to promote internal collaborations between Africa-focused Science, Policy and Education initiatives at Imperial and build bridges with external partners, focusing specifically on STEMB (Science, Technology, Engineering, Medicine and Business). Africa Innovates cultivates an interdisciplinary dialogue for key researchers, shapers, and decision-makers to explore innovative ideas of how to address some of the grand challenges that African societies are facing today. title: Weird Weather: The rise of climate conspiracy theories & disinformation
desc:
From blistering heatwaves to record-breaking rainfall and unseasonal cold snaps, our weather is becoming more erratic and extreme. But as our weather gets weirder, so do the stories surrounding it.

Join the Grantham Institute for a thought-provoking discussion on the rise of conspiracy theories and disinformation about our changing climate.

​Hear from two experts in the field: Simon Clark , YouTuber and Atmospheric Physicist, and Pallavi Sethi , Climate Change Misinformation Policy Fellow at the Grantham Research Institute, LSE. Together, they’ll unpack how mis- and disinformation are shaping people’s perceptions of the climate crisis and explore what this means for how climate science is talked about in the media, politics and everyday life.

​Limited seating; advance registration…

desc: As robotics and generative AI rapidly evolve and become integral to everyday life, there is an urgent need for innovators who can design technologies that are not only intelligent but also ethical, sustainable, and socially responsible. title: Design Engineering for Innovation Summer School
desc:
Welcome to the Design Engineering Summer School!

This Summer School offers a unique opportunity to gain insights into creativity, innovation, and design through a combination of inspiring lectures and hands-on workshops. You will explore evolutionary, revolutionary, and experimental methods for design-led innovation, with modules covering cutting-edge topics such as data-centric design, AI in immersive audio design, and smart cities. These subjects are designed to complement your engineering background and inspire new approaches to innovation.
